visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black shirt stands in front of a white paneled wall, holding a wooden plate with fake plastic food. He looks towards the side, speaking to another character played by himself wearing a white shirt and a tall white paper chef's hat. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of food hacks. Hands mix white sugar into a small white plate of red ketchup. A golden-brown french fry is dipped into the mixture. Then, chicken nuggets are placed atop a large beef burger, and more fries are stirred into a cup of yellow corn soup. (3) The man in the black shirt reappears, looking disappointed and touching his face with his hand while his 'chef' persona looks thoughtful and strokes his chin. Yellow and red fire graphics explode around the chef. (4) A transition leads to the man wearing a bright floral shirt sitting at a grey couch behind a wooden table. The table is covered with McDonald's branded bags, white paper cups with the yellow 'M' logo, and multiple open burger boxes containing various sandwiches and nuggets. (5) Close-up shots demonstrate a sequence of new food combinations: a yellow sauce is poured over a hash brown and a curry nugget; the man takes large bites of a chicken burger filled with apple pie filling; and a thick cheese sauce is squeezed onto a beef burger. (6) The man in the floral shirt sits back, chewing and gesturing with his hands to express satisfaction. He points at the food spread and then toward the camera while talking directly to the viewer.
